reader.requirement: At --std 85 an END PROGRAM program-name header must end exactly the named source program: what follows belongs to its container (a sibling contained program or the container's own end header) or, after an outermost program, to a separately compiled program; so names and program-name scope end at the header, and a header that does not end the program it stands after (wrong name, out of order, the 2002 END FUNCTION form) is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Year >= 2002: a program containing programs must have a procedure division; at 85 (§1985:X.2.3.1 prints [ procedure-division ] [ source-program ] … as separate brackets) it need not

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|Year|DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry over EndMarkerPass.cs (none: its SR1/SR2/SR3 screen is edition-neutral and matches §1985:X.2.5.3 SR2/SR3 and X.2.3.2 SR1), SourceUnitShape.cs (the one arm above) and the grammar rules (no predicate on programUnit/nestedProgram/endProgramHeader).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a container needs no procedure division before its contained programs (accepted at 85, COBOL2274 at 2023); the meaning of the end program header itself is the same
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers two sibling contained programs and a separately compiled program after the outer end header; not exercised there: the refusal half (wrong name, reversed headers, a statement after a contained program's header, END FUNCTION), program-name scope ending at the header, and the 85-only container without a procedure division

probes.printed: error COBOL2793: the end marker names 'P11X', but the program-name declared in the PROGRAM-ID paragraph it ends is 'P11A'
probes.expected: §1985:X.2.5.3 SR2: the program-name must be identical to a declared program-name

probes.printed: error COBOL2793 (x2): the end markers of nested programs are out of order
probes.expected: §1985:X.2.5.3 SR3: the inner program's end header must precede the container's
§1985:X.2.5.4 GR3: after a contained program's end header the next statement must be an Identification Division header or another end program header

probes.printed: error COBOL2274: END FUNCTION cannot close a program definition
probes.expected: the 85 format is END PROGRAM program-name only

probes.printed: error COBOL2793: PROGRAM-ID 'P11FA' precedes another source unit, so its end marker END PROGRAM P11FA shall be present
probes.expected: without the header P11FA has not ended (X.2.2), so P11FB would be contained and lacks the header X.2.3.2 SR1 b requires: nonconforming either way

probes.printed: GI INN / GS CANNOT CALL GI
probes.expected: after END PROGRAM P11GO, P11GS is separately compiled, so the non-common P11GI contained in P11GO is not callable from it (X.1.3.8.1 (1)): CALL takes ON OVERFLOW

probes.printed: --std 85 compile-only: EXIT 0; --std 2023: error COBOL2274 ... shall have a procedure division
probes.expected: §1985:X.2.3.1 admits [ procedure-division ] and [ source-program ] … as separate optional items

reader.notes: The grammar closes the innermost open unit at each endProgramHeader and EndMarkerPass.ScreenProgram refuses a header whose name is not that unit's (wrong or reversed), so a header always ends the program it names; the next ID DIVISION is a sibling or a separate program. Every probe behaved as the 1985 text requires; diagnostics cite §2023:10.7.3 though the 85 rules are X.2.5.3.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: r6a_no_id_header_after_end (a contained sibling after END PROGRAM R6AA begins at PROGRAM-ID with no IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header; GR3 demands that header at 85): refused COBOL0900 'a source unit without the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header requires COBOL-2002' (an 85 arm the reader did not list, on the source-unit header path; correct). r6b_stmt_after_outer_end (PROCEDURE DIVISION after the outermost END PROGRAM; GR4): refused COBOL0001. r6c_lowercase_name ('end program r6ci.' for PROGRAM-ID R6CI): accepted, runs, I (case-equivalent words). r6d_no_period (END PROGRAM R6DI without its separator period, which the 85 format prints): refused COBOL0001. r6e_outer_end_missing (outer program containing one, its header absent at EOF; GR1): refused COBOL2793. r6f_global_scope_ends (a separately compiled program after END PROGRAM R6FO references R6FO's GLOBAL GG): refused COBOL1639, so names end at the header. cite.py: OK §1985:X.2.5.4 GR1; OK GR2; OK GR3; OK GR4.
edition-sites-missed: the source-unit header check that emits COBOL0900 'a source unit without the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header requires COBOL-2002': refuses the header-less form at 85 and admits it from 2002 (the reader's edition-consulted list names only SourceUnitShape.ContainedFollowProcedureDivision); its 85 arm is correct
